source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify BMC User Settings defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without exposing credentials, weakening privilege policy, triggering unintended lockout, deleting or disabling the last administrator, or losing independent OOB recovery.
original_method: Using disposable lab identities and a preserved independent administrator, manually load defaults, compare named non-secret user/role/policy fields with SPEC, apply a bounded matrix, save/reboot, verify persistence through approved authentication and audit evidence, then restore policy.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually accept the BIOS BMC-user workflow and perform credential entry through the approved secret-handling path. Automated auth/audit checks are supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identity and user-setting field semantics
Approved disposable lab account, role/channel privilege and enable/disable matrix
Password/lockout/session policy and credential rotation procedure
Independent administrator not modified by the test plus local console/recovery
Secret-redaction evidence plan and audit expectations
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or change production accounts, the last administrator, authentication sources or lockout policy without exact approval.
Never print, log, screenshot or commit passwords, tokens, recovery secrets or password hashes.
Use a disposable lab account and preserve an independently verified administrator and local recovery path.
Do not weaken privileges or enable default/shared credentials to make the test pass.
Stop before lockout, last-path loss, unexpected privilege escalation, audit failure or management degradation.
Restore/rotate the approved policy; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect only non-secret user IDs, enabled state, roles/channel privileges, policy metadata, auth success/failure outcome, audit/session logs and BMC/host health where authorized.
Compare approved expected behavior without receiving or replaying credentials in evidence.
Do not drive BIOS, create/delete users, set passwords, change roles, authenticate with unapproved secrets or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve fields/accounts/roles/policies, secret handling, final state and independent recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded user-policy phases with all secrets redacted.
Verify recovery administrator and interpret access/audit evidence; issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; direct Redfish/IPMI/WebUI user management is a different control path and not equivalent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the BIOS method and add version-recorded, credential-free read-only account/role/policy metadata, authentication outcomes and audit evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each BIOS control to one disposable account's enabled state, role/channel privilege, lockout/session behavior and audit event; preserve a separate administrator and record outcomes without secrets.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/BMC user model, channels, roles and authentication policy.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, Redfish/IPMI schema/tool and authentication/audit implementation versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC user-management documentation and approved access-control/credential policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random user changes with a least-privilege disposable-account matrix and explicit secret/recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds role, lockout, audit and recovery validation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fields, disposable identity, roles, policies, secret handling and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only APIs may redact or normalize privileges and cannot prove BIOS UI state; firmware captures remain required.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve selected user/role/policy fields using lab credentials. Results must state excluded auth sources/channels and never include secrets or claim all access-control behavior.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, redacted account/role/default matrix, secret policy, approval and recovery
Baseline non-secret accounts/roles/policies, auth/audit and BMC health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and recovery-admin validation
Non-default captures, persistence, least-privilege auth outcomes and audit trail
Approved final policy/credential rotation, redacted logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The named user-settings and default/persistence lifecycle are coherent. Exact accounts/roles and secret handling are project readiness inputs, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The BMC user-setting lifecycle is clear. Missing lab identities or recovery prevents a run but does not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual BIOS operation and adds credential, least-privilege, lockout and recovery safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its non-secret auth/audit evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates BIOS acceptance from direct BMC user APIs and prevents secret collection or last-account risk.

review_improvement: Prevents persistence testing from leaking credentials, weakening roles or locking out the only recovery administrator while making authentication and audit effects attributable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core acceptance requires human BIOS and credential handling. Automated metadata/auth checks cannot complete those manual activities, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat user/role/password changes or authentication attempts after lockout, privilege, audit or access anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
